end.name_en: Langgen Distribution Station (Tieshan Donggang Industrial Park)
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '榄根' bounded to Beihai/Hepu -> OSM way 991683301 '榄根路' (Langgen Road), 合浦县, 北海市, adjacent to OSM way 1135120005 '铁山东港区玉林海港码头' (Tieshan Donggang Yulin sea port terminal) confirming the industrial-park location; road centroid used as a proxy for the co-located station.

corridor_notes: 12.6km branch ('东港支线') from PipeChina's national-trunk Baisha gas transmission station (国家管网白沙输气站, Baisha Town, Hepu County) to Langgen distribution station (榄根分输站) inside the Tieshan Donggang Industrial Park (铁山东港产业园), on the Hepu County/Tieshan Port District boundary. Design pressure 4 MPa. Built/operated by Guangxi Beihai Guangtou Gas Co. (广西北海广投燃气有限公司) with 广投管网公司 (Guangxi Investment Group's pipeline-network subsidiary). Gas-in/pressure test completed 2024-03-29 (18:35 gas from Baisha reached Langgen; pressure test to 3.8MPa completed 2024-03-29 14:06); official commissioning with first industrial customers (新福兴, 长利 — both glass manufacturers) 2024-08-19.
researcher_notes: Re-verified gxbhlg.com and gigeps.com live this pass (both 200). gxbhlg.com (the project co-developer's own news page) is a strong single-source route description naming both stations and the exact 12.6km length directly. nengyuanquan.com (the pilot digest's second corroborating source, syndicating the same story with commissioning-date detail) failed url_verifier this pass (ConnectTimeout) and the Wayback API was rate-limited (429) on repeated attempts, so it is NOT included as a ref here even though the pilot digest read it successfully — flagging as a re-check item. gigeps.com/61178 (2025-06-27 feasibility-study procurement notice for a FOLLOW-ON project in the same industrial park) corroborates the area's active buildout but does not itself name P7665's two endpoint stations. Pilot digest already checked P7665 against the roster (incl. P7664) for duplicates and found none (different route, different status, different diameter class) — reconfirmed on this pass; not a duplicate.
